title: Dual-Branch HNSW Approach with Skip Bridges and LID-Driven Optimization

contributions.purpose: 缓解 HNSW 贪婪搜索陷入局部最优、簇断连的问题,同时加快构建速度
contributions.mechanism: 双分支 HNSW 图结构,增加导航路径多样性,允许从多个方向遍历
contributions.evaluation: 六个 CV/NLP 数据集上相对原始 HNSW recall 提升(NLP 18%,CV 最高 30%),构建时间最多减少 20%;消融显示双分支贡献次于 LID 插入
contributions.domain: 近似最近邻(ANN)检索 / 向量索引
contributions.source_quote: A dual-branch HNSW graph structure that increases the diversity of navigation paths, re-duces construction time, and mitigates search stagnation in local optima, thereby improving recall and accuracy.

contributions.purpose: 改善簇间连通性,进一步降低局部最优风险
contributions.mechanism: 基于局部内在维度(LID)的节点插入策略,把离群点(高 LID)优先插入更高层
contributions.evaluation: 消融研究表明 LID 插入对性能影响最大,是三组件中贡献最高者
contributions.domain: 近似最近邻(ANN)检索 / 向量索引
contributions.source_quote: A LID-based node insertion strategy for HNSW graphs, prioritizing outliers to higher layers to improve inter-cluster connectivity, further reducing local optima and enhancing perfor-mance.

contributions.purpose: 加速查询过程,弥补双分支引入的额外计算开销,使 O(n log n) 复杂度更可达
contributions.mechanism: 基于 LID 阈值的跳层桥接(bridges),绕过冗余的中间层
contributions.evaluation: 维持推理速度不变(定性:未观察到 trade-off);量化查询加速见正文
contributions.domain: 近似最近邻(ANN)检索 / 向量索引
contributions.source_quote: LID-based threshold layer-skipping bridges that significantly accelerate the query process.

self_declared_provenance.quote: (Malkov & Yashunin, 2020) introduced HNSW as a multi-layered graph structure that allows efficient neigh-borhood exploration in high-dimensional spaces.
(Elliott & Clark, 2024) highlighted the critical influence of data insertion order on intrinsic dimensionality and overall re-call performance.

notes: 作者显式且反复声称『We did not observe any trade-offs in our algorithm』——罕见地主张零 trade-off(准确率与构建速度提升同时维持推理速度)。构建速度提升伴随双分支带来的额外开销,由桥接组件弥补。无负结果报告。
